topology_policy: Blade, guard fan, wings, grip, and pommel are deliberately distinct physical/design components; each component is an editable contiguous mesh rather than accumulated detail primitives.
human_review: Rejected by the user as poorly modeled. This candidate is not an acceptable likeness, high-poly, or low-poly asset. The review invalidates using its technical audit as proof of professional modeling capability.
required_before_retry: Study and verify the prioritized reference/multi-view curriculum episodes.
Use a same-object multi-angle reference plan with measured landmarks and stated depth uncertainty.
Obtain a primary-form/silhouette review before ornament, UV, or high/low packaging.
claim_boundary: Front-view technical interpretation only. UV presence and material assignment are technical preparation checks, not proof of production-ready unwrap quality, visual fidelity, or complete reference coverage.
